name: CORE
author: Xadegamer
description:
A game created by Pelumi, Jack HK and Nico.

Welcome to CORE. A puzzle-adventure game made in two days for the 2020 GameJam! In CORE, you have to try and escape the unstable nuclear facility in order to save yourself from a horrific nightmare. There are three rooms filled with puzzles taking advantage of physics, colours and Unity's features.

Theme: Secrets
Creation Time: Two days

Thanks for playing, see you at the next Jam!
